mapping.HOME: home (text environment input, empty default when unset; explicit --input home=... overrides)
mapping.positional_arguments: arguments list (accepted and ignored, like upstream)

platform: Bash plus Unix printf/test/sed; preserves the host sed dialect. GNU sed supports uppercase replacement \u; macOS BSD sed emits literal u. Linux desktop behavior not exercised.
